historical_reviews.deepseek: Selects the correct read-only wrapper and full output, but leaves raw response length, byte-numbering convention, countdown fields and non-mutation controls implicit.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE with protected raw/wrapper query, complete field decoding, collection time, volatile-state interpretation and no watchdog mutation.
historical_reviews.round_02: Accepted as automated OOB read with ipmitool and operator-selected target; only command-exit-level static sanity was recorded.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: Reset reloads the countdown and Set changes the policy; this case must not call either operation when reporting an active or anomalous timer.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Retain exact Get coverage and bind the project parser/version and any owner-policy comparator without converting observations into control actions.

original_test_intent: Read the selected BMC watchdog configuration and live countdown over OOB IPMI, decode the returned timer-use, action, pre-timeout and expiration state, and preserve enough raw evidence to distinguish an armed, expired or unsupported timer without altering it.
original_method: Master raw 0x06/0x25 is preserved; the `mc watchdog get` wrapper is equivalent only when its output retains all response fields. The parser must state whether byte numbering includes the protocol completion byte because `ipmitool raw` presents only response data on success.
manual_activity: Engineer approves the watchdog field/owner interpretation and adjudicates active, expired or contradictory state; no physical or configuration action belongs to this case.
required_inputs: IPMI Get Watchdog Timer response schema
Documented completion-inclusive versus data-only byte numbering
Optional project watchdog-owner and expected-policy reference
safety_requirements: Do not clear SEL, dmesg or syslog
Reject Reset, Set, off or power commands
Require successful completion and full response length
Redact credentials without losing target identity
Never auto-remediate an armed or expired timer
agent_execution_scope: Verify OOB target and session protection
Issue one bounded raw 0x06/0x25 or proven equivalent get wrapper
Decode timer use, action, pre-timeout, expiration flags, initial count and present count
Record collection time and optional read-only owner correlation
Archive raw and decoded evidence with a non-mutation audit
engineer_actions: Confirm decoder and any platform-specific bit interpretation
Provide expected policy only when comparison is required
Investigate safety-relevant active or expired state separately

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `mc watchdog get` fits the read purpose, but its formatted output must be traceable to raw 0x06/0x25 fields and must not omit the initial or present countdown.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected `ipmitool ... raw 0x06 0x25` for auditable bytes or a version-pinned `mc watchdog get` plus retained raw-equivalent fields; perform no follow-up mutation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The single read and 10/5 timing metadata remain unchanged.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture a timestamped raw response and a structured decode that explicitly maps protocol byte numbers to ipmitool data-byte positions and preserves volatile countdown values.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds complete-length validation, countdown decoding, byte-numbering clarity, protected credentials and a strict observation-only boundary while rejecting log clearing.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A formatted wrapper is complete only if all Master fields and both countdown values remain auditable; inventory or log output alone does not replace 0x06/0x25.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Countdown changes during collection, and mixing completion-inclusive specification numbering with data-only tool output can shift every decoded field and create a false policy report.

project_override_considerations: A Redfish or vendor watchdog view is supplementary unless the project explicitly approves it with a demonstrated field-by-field mapping to the Master IPMI Get Watchdog Timer response.
expected_evidence: Verified BMC-host identity, interface and parser versions
Timestamped raw 0x06/0x25 response and completion status
Response-length check and declared byte-numbering convention
Decoded timer use, actions, pre-timeout, expiration flags, initial count and present count
Proof that no timer, host power, BMC state or logs changed

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source raw command and DeepSeek wrapper are consistent. The source's Byte 2-5 labels can be reconciled by documenting that the IPMI specification counts completion code while successful `ipmitool raw` output starts at response data.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The standard read is deterministic. Target and parser bindings are normal readiness inputs; malformed or uninterpretable output blocks execution evidence, not the static review.

review_improvement: Defines the complete response, resolves byte-index ambiguity, includes initial/present countdown evidence and prohibits mutation or log clearing when a safety-relevant timer state is observed.
independent_technical_reasoning: A watchdog read is time-sensitive telemetry: the present count can change between displays, while the configuration fields should remain stable. Correct review therefore needs one timestamped atomic response, an explicit byte-index basis and retention of raw bytes. Treating only a successful exit or a formatted summary as evidence could hide a truncated response or decode every field one byte off.
